race.comment: CARDONETTE (9) has returned in great touch and gets the chance to flex more of her muscle where she should get a tempo to suit. Watch for Thompson hooking her to the outside and letting down strongly. PODIUM STAR (14) has built nicely into this with two close fourths and now has first-time blinkers to help sharpen him. Note winning hoop JGC reunites. NO FOOLING (4) has not quite delivered in two runs back but reunites with Maloney and is another will appreciate a strong tempo so he can launch late. HELLARIOUS (13) resumes. Fresh after a trial win and was close up in BM70 company before the break. In the mix.
